title: Spiriti! Napoli '97
name: spiriti-napoli97
summary: Naples, 1997: answer the calls, race the lungomare and trap six spirits before the Vesuvius wakes.
description: An unofficial paranormal arcade tribute set in Naples in 1997. Pick a haunted district on the dispatch map, drive the response Fiat 500 along the lungomare dodging ectoplasm and collecting espresso, then hold each spirit in the proton beam and steer the trap under it before the pack overheats or the spirit's patience runs out. Six districts - Centro Storico, Mergellina, Vomero, Porto, Fuorigrotta and Capodimonte - lead to a three-round apparition in the crater of the Vesuvius, while the city's psychokinetic energy stains the night sky. Palette-indexed pixel art with exact colours on the ESP32-C6, palette effects, and an original eight-track SID-like soundtrack with stereo-panned effects. Unofficial tribute; unaffiliated with the Ghostbusters rights holders.
controls: Map: LEFT/RIGHT choose, A dispatch. Drive: UP/DOWN lanes, RIGHT/LEFT accelerate/brake. Capture: hold A for the beam, LEFT/RIGHT move the trap, B give up. SELECT high scores.
content_notice: Unofficial tribute; no copied franchise logo, soundtrack, dialogue, sprites or game data. Not affiliated with the Ghostbusters rights holders.
